en: 2 Timothy 2

p.src: 1  You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

en: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
u.src: 1  You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

p.src: 2  The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

en: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
u.src: 2  The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

p.src: 3  You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

en: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
u.src: 3  You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

p.src: 4  No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

en: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

p.src: 5  Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

en: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

p.src: 6  The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

en: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

p.src: 7  Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

en: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

p.src: 8  Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

en: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

en: 2:8 or, seed

p.src: 9  in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

p.src: 10  Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

u.src: 10  Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

p.src: 11  This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

en: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
u.src: 11  This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

p.src: 12  If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

en: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
u.src: 12  If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

en: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

p.src: 14  Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

en: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

p.src: 15  Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

en: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
u.src: 15  Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

p.src: 16  But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

en: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
